owner_reported_rehearsal.source: Owner-supplied rehearsal facts; not the linked 1 October findings record
owner_reported_rehearsal.observations: Owner-reported personal-site rehearsal, 2 October 2026: Sonnet 5.5 received the first Notification at 75 seconds with two Alerts, then updates at 134 and 196 seconds. Traffic restarted on the cue at 209 seconds; the Incident reached Completed with resolution at 291 seconds. Four Runs cost $0.94. Across takes, investigation added approximately 2–25 seconds to the create Run: 31.7–54.4 seconds versus a 29.3-second baseline. These observations do not establish acceptance of every later fix, every telemetry backend or the unavailable-evidence fallback.
owner_reported_rehearsal.restart_explanation: Restart traffic when the sustained-outage update Run finishes. In the recorded Sonnet presenter take, this cue occurred 209 seconds after the stop, so the optional repeat stage did not occur.
